QuestInfo.name: Victoria or Bust
QuestInfo.0: With Kino Konoko's information on Maple World, you can begin your investigation of this new land. First stop, Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.1: Find Athena Pierce in the town of Henesys on Victoria Island. Then speak to Warp Helper Perry the Pelican in Mushroom Shrine to get to Six Path Crossway. From there, walk to Henesys.
QuestInfo.2: You found Athena Pierce looking for you. Did you do something wrong?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\nCan proceed to Grendel the Possibly Useful quest.

0.0: I must pay a visit to this Victoria Island, to learn the lay of the land. Afterwards, I can investigate Ereve, Edelstein, and Ossyria. Perhaps one of them will have a decent millet stew.
0.1: The shrine maiden suggested Athena Pierce in Henesys. I am uncertain what a pelican is, or whether I should trust it above a well-made atakebune, but I am a foreigner here. I will go to this Six Path Crossway, and do what I must to reach Henesys.

1.0: Hey you! I need to talk to you.
